title: Hatsune Miku — Stage SEKAI〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You guys were amazing today!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Just one more song!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's have fun on stage until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great singing, Miku and Rin! I brought you some towels.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that's just what I needed! Thanks, Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This one's for you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank YOU for checking out our performance!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was our pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But wouldn't you have preferred it if we watched you sing and dance from the audience seats?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nope! It's useful to know how the performers sharing the stage look too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, I'm glad we could help!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let us know if there's anything else we can do for you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Don't be shy and show us every new performance!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You guys are great, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
By the way, Airi...
Wasn't there something you wanted to ask them?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Was there? Ah, that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You've got a question for us? Alright, shoot!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's a bit personal, I hope you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What's your selling point?
Like, what's your theme?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Our...selling point?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And theme?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't think we've got anything in the sense you're asking. We do gigs together, but we're not an idol group.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously?! How come you can sing and dance so well if you're not a tight-knit idol group driven by a shared vision?! Maybe it's down to you being VIRTUAL SINGERS...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But if you did settle on a theme, and got a producer to market you, you could become a phenomenon out of this world!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Miku could go for the pure and innocent girl theme.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rin, you have the makings of a top younger sister type idol... Together, you could amplify each other's appeal!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um... What do you want us to do, exactly?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, Airi's totally obsessed with all things related to idol groups.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The original idol duo who made it big were PINKY WINK. They went with the cool and mysterious vibes that were popular back then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Recently, there are only few duos.
Most idols either work solo, or as part of big groups.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I think you have huge potential as a duo of two idols with different themes! Sometimes you pull in different directions, but it highlights each other's best points...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're smiling to yourself, Miku. What are you thinking?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: About this SEKAI, how it's created from the energy of lots and lots of shows.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's filled with the happy emotions fans feel when watching their idols performing on stage.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It made me itch to do more shows too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, same here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's keep doing them together then!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But in the end we didn't decide on themes for you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's the one downside of having ridiculously huge potential. It makes it harder to narrow down which way of producing you as idols would be best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, you tried, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks for putting so much thought into it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oooh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's the matter, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Since our role is to help people discover their true feelings...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Couldn't we be helper idols?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Helpers, huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about angelic idols helping out those in need?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then you can incorporate the pure and innocent, and younger sister themes into that! But why stop there...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, she's on a roll now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It seems we're going to learn a lot about idols today♪
